## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION, Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector participation and cyclical pockets leading (Utilities, Consumer Discretionary). Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 from 3 sectors) — major-cap divergence (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) warrants tactical caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing strength: MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials lag: DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND, sector showing weakness. Industrials mixed with notable weakness: DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, UBER (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -3.86%) BELOW TREND. Technology shows rotation/correction in large caps: NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, NEE (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.00%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Industrials, Materials and Utilities names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +79.45%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +15.60%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR divergence across big caps (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT) which tempers broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed, with large-cap corrections and mid-cap strength; AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION — Tech breadth: 16/24 positive (internal rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials holding up with pockets of recovery: JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY — Financials breadth: 14/20 positive; style: Value/cyclical cues present but mixed.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive and leading in pockets: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare breadth: 13/17 positive and confirming recent bullish news flow.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective cyclicals and resilient healthcare names (QCOM, IBM, LLY, MRK, F) and reduce exposure to large-cap tech names showing 1W weakness (NVDA, GOOGL, INTU) until trend confirmation; rotation toward value/cyclicals is the tactical tilt. Monitor major-cap divergence and sentiment mismatches before adding to core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities (Sector Strength; e.g., VST RECOVERY, CEG ABOVE TREND) and Healthcare (Sector Strength; LLY/MRK ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Materials (Sector Weakness; DOW BELOW TREND) and selective Industrials (DE BELOW TREND, UBER BELOW TREND) — watch for spillovers into cyclicals.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: failure to reclaim the recent 1W low would deepen CORRECTION and signal broader tech risk. AAPL: holding 1M uptrend would confirm secular leadership (ABOVE TREND continuation). INTU: reclaiming the prior week’s range is required to arrest BELOW TREND momentum; JPM: sustained move above recent swing highs would validate RECOVERY.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVDA (+85): Board authorizes $80B buyback — price in CORRECTION, sentiment/divergence (bullish news but short-term selling). IBM (+65): Quantum/announcements — price ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming accumulation. MRK (+60): Phase 3 success — price ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming. LLY (+65): Positive Phase 3 obesity data — price ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AMGN (-75): regulatory warnings in Japan — check positioning (price not in detailed view, monitor for confirmation). BAC (-55): downgrade and insider selling pressure — bank sentiment negative despite Financials' broader strength (watch for divergence). META (-45): legal headwinds — price BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming weakness. HD (-50): target cuts vs 1W RECOVERY (HD (1W: +5.23% | 1M: -7.96%) RECOVERY) — sentiment diverging from price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership as sector participation is broad but leadership concentrated across a few pockets. QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergence (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT 1W vs 1M mismatch) and bullish news on NVDA while price falls — watch for trend breaks before enlarging exposures.
